title: Michael C: Google chairman OAuth module, consent flow, michael_credentials, credential-venue change (host Task Scheduler, GHA credential-free per ff4ef5b4) with SECURITY sub-agent evidence row with provenance, requireAuth on /api/michael/*
description: Child C (Google chairman OAuth) of SD-LEO-ORCH-MICHAEL-ROLE-FORMALIZATION-002: generalize lib/integrations/youtube/oauth-manager.js into lib/integrations/google/chairman-oauth.js using the host .env GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, tokens AES-256-GCM encrypted with lib/security/encryption.cjs in michael_credentials (one row, google_chairman_oauth, decrypted only on the chairman's host), and one consent flow scripts/michael/google-consent.mjs on localhost:3456 requesting gmail.modify, calendar.readonly and drive.readonly (youtube deferred to v1.1). This child carries the credential-venue change of ratification ff4ef5b4: credentialed feeders run on Windows Task Scheduler on the host, GitHub Actions stays credential-free (ratification 0daf3bd8 intact), and no MICHAEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID or GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET enters GHA secrets. It requires a SECURITY sub-agent evidence row with provenance (producer, run id, content hash per ratification 6c263823) and puts GET /api/michael/* behind requireAuth in server/index.js. Under the seven-day re-consent posture (D4, ratification 8e6ac764) the michael-oauth-health gauge is the warning source and the re-consent runbook is one host command. Source of record: docs/michael/02-SPEC.md v0.3 section 4.
scope: Child SD of SD-LEO-ORCH-MICHAEL-ROLE-FORMALIZATION-002: Michael C: Google chairman OAuth module, consent flow, michael_credentials, credential-venue change (host Task Scheduler, GHA credential-free per ff4ef5b4) with SECURITY sub-agent evidence row with provenance, requireAuth on /api/michael/*

key_changes.change: lib/security/encryption.cjs additionally exports the CredentialEncryption class (module.exports.CredentialEncryption) so a caller can bind a different master-key source without duplicating the AES-256-GCM/PBKDF2 code; the default singleton and every existing caller are unchanged
key_changes.impact: Child C can refuse-without-key and fingerprint the key while keeping storage on the established precedent (oauth-manager.js, token-vault.js)

key_changes.change: lib/integrations/google/chairman-oauth.js (ESM, mirrors lib/integrations/youtube/oauth-manager.js): SCOPES gmail.modify + calendar.readonly + drive.readonly (youtube deferred to v1.1), redirect http://localhost:3456/oauth2callback, CREDENTIAL_IDENTIFIER='google_chairman_oauth'; a HostKeyEncryption subclass whose getMasterKey reads MICHAEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY (64 hex chars) and throws MICHAEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY_MISSING otherwise; assertHostVenue() throws when GITHUB_ACTIONS or CI is set; getStoredTokens/storeTokens read and upsert michael_credentials (encrypted_blob, encryption_metadata, key_fingerprint = first 16 hex of sha256(key), scopes, expires_at from expiry_date, last_refreshed_at, last_error null on success); getAuthenticatedClient refreshes an expired access token and on invalid_grant writes last_error='invalid_grant' and rethrows; runConsentFlow opens the browser, catches the callback on 3456 and stores the tokens; every function takes injectable { sb, enc } for tests
key_changes.impact: One grant, ciphertext only at rest, decrypt only on the host, the gauge's two predicates (last_error='invalid_grant', expires_at) are written by the module itself

key_changes.change: scripts/michael/google-consent.mjs: the one-command re-consent runbook on the host (runs runConsentFlow with prompt=consent; --status prints identifier, scopes, expires_at, last_refreshed_at, last_error and key_fingerprint with no blob; --json); exits 2 with a named refusal when MICHAEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID or GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET is absent or when run under GITHUB_ACTIONS; refuses before the browser opens when michael_credentials is not applied (TABLES_ABSENT, the lib/michael/db.mjs pattern)
key_changes.impact: Re-consent posture D4 is one host command; nothing can be granted into an unrecordable store

key_changes.change: lib/michael/gmail-client.mjs: modifyThread({ threadId, addLabelIds, removeLabelIds }) -> { ok, modified } on googleapis gmail.users.threads.modify with the chairman OAuth client, the exact lazy-import contract scripts/michael/gmail-act.mjs (child B) already expects; an auth or API failure returns { ok:false, error }
key_changes.impact: gmail-act stops exiting GMAIL_CLIENT_ABSENT; label, archive and --unarchive reach the mailbox through the one grant

key_changes.change: server/routes/michael.js (GET /oauth/status reading michael_credentials without encrypted_blob or encryption_metadata, adding hours_to_expiry) mounted in server/index.js as app.use('/api/michael', requireAuth, michaelRoutes) beside the other requireAuth mounts
key_changes.impact: GET /api/michael/* is unreachable unauthenticated; the response can never carry token material

key_changes.change: Tests with injected clients (vitest unit project): chairman-oauth refuses without MICHAEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY, refuses under GITHUB_ACTIONS, writes no plaintext token field and stamps key_fingerprint, records last_error='invalid_grant' on a failed refresh; gmail-client maps the modify call and failure shape; the michael route omits blob fields and returns 401 through requireAuth when unauthenticated. No migration in this child: michael_credentials already ships in 20260906_michael_tables.sql (child B, chairman-gated)
key_changes.impact: The refusal paths and the no-plaintext invariant are pinned before the chairman applies -B and consents

strategic_objectives: Give Michael one chairman-user Google grant: lib/integrations/google/chairman-oauth.js generalizes the YouTube OAuth manager for gmail.modify, calendar.readonly and drive.readonly, storing only AES-256-GCM ciphertext in michael_credentials (identifier google_chairman_oauth) and decrypting only on the chairman's host

Resolve the key source the -B migration left open: the master key is MICHAEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY in the host .env and nowhere else; the module refuses to run without it and never auto-generates a key, and stamps key_fingerprint so a wrong-key decrypt is diagnosable

Carry the credential-venue change of ratification ff4ef5b4 in code: any process with GITHUB_ACTIONS set is refused before a decrypt, so GitHub Actions stays credential-free (0daf3bd8) and no GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET or MICHAEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY is needed in GHA secrets

Land the Gmail API leg child B deferred (lib/michael/gmail-client.mjs modifyThread) and put GET /api/michael/* behind requireAuth with a read-only credential-status route that never returns token material, so the michael-oauth-health gauge (child G) and the dashboard (child H) have a source

Make the seven-day re-consent posture (D4, 8e6ac764) operable: invalid_grant is recorded as last_error, expires_at is kept current on refresh, and re-consent is one host command (node scripts/michael/google-consent.mjs)

success_criteria.measure: Unit test asserts the upsert payload contains encrypted_blob/encryption_metadata/key_fingerprint/scopes/expires_at/last_refreshed_at and no access_token/refresh_token/id_token key; grep of the diff finds no plaintext token column
success_criteria.criterion: No plaintext token is ever written: every storeTokens write to michael_credentials carries encrypted_blob (base64 from encryption.cjs) and encryption_metadata, and no field of the OAuth token object appears in the row

success_criteria.measure: Unit test: with the variable unset getStoredTokens/storeTokens/runConsentFlow throw MICHAEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY_MISSING and write nothing; with a 64-hex value the row's key_fingerprint equals the first 16 hex of sha256(key)
success_criteria.criterion: Key source resolved: the module derives its key only from MICHAEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY and never auto-generates one

success_criteria.measure: Unit test: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true makes assertHostVenue throw before any decrypt; grep .github/workflows for MICHAEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET returns nothing
success_criteria.criterion: Credential venue: the grant cannot be used from GitHub Actions

success_criteria.measure: node scripts/michael/google-consent.mjs --status exits 0 and prints the row without a blob; a refresh that fails with invalid_grant leaves last_error='invalid_grant' (unit test); a successful refresh updates expires_at and last_refreshed_at
success_criteria.criterion: Re-consent posture is operable from one host command and the gauge predicates are written by the module

success_criteria.measure: node scripts/michael/gmail-act.mjs --thread t1 --archive --dry-run no longer exits GMAIL_CLIENT_ABSENT; unit test maps modifyThread to gmail.users.threads.modify with { addLabelIds, removeLabelIds } and returns { ok:true, modified:true }
success_criteria.criterion: gmail-act's deferred API leg is landed

success_criteria.measure: server/index.js mounts /api/michael with requireAuth (grep); route unit test asserts the /oauth/status payload has no encrypted_blob or encryption_metadata key
success_criteria.criterion: GET /api/michael/* is behind requireAuth and returns no token material

success_criteria.measure: sub_agent_execution_results row for this SD with sub_agent_code=SECURITY, phase=EXEC, metadata.content_hash, session_id and evaluated_commit_sha set (ratification 6c263823)
success_criteria.criterion: SECURITY sub-agent evidence row with provenance exists before EXEC-TO-PLAN
